audience: Learners in robotic + human integration training
description: Robotics training: human-robot integration in a shared cell — safety zone first, controls and hand-guiding, a guided pick-and-place task, a human handover, and a debrief. Grounded in the SmartCiti.X repo's own framing ("Gamified training to enhance robotic and human integrations"); the repo describes 11 simulators as part of its bundle — no simulator is named here beyond that repo copy, and no performance figure is claimed. Simulation only — not certification.

halls.note: No hall mapped. Trade halls in the Holodeck player (per vr-entry README): Ironworkers, Welding Trades, Boilermakers, Millwrights. Hall mapping is open (Phase 4).

stations.title: Safety zone — cell boundary, e-stop, PPE
Control panel — mode select, hand-guiding controls
Work cell — robot arm, task bench, handover point

steps.action: Safety zone: PPE check, confirm the cell boundary and the e-stop.
steps.check: PPE fits; boundary and e-stop confirmed.

steps.action: Control panel: select the training mode and confirm hand-guiding is on.
Guided task: hand-guide the arm through the pick-and-place path.
Handover: the robot presents the part; the learner takes it at the handover point.
steps.check: Handover complete; hands clear of the cell.

steps.action: Return the arm to home, log the run, and debrief with the coach.
steps.check: Arm homed; run logged; debrief complete.
